title: Linking a social/OIDC account whose email doesn't match: the callback's error=email_does_not_match is never shown — the console bounces the signed-in user away
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33058 · identity-auth.linked-accounts-social · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (stock showcase @ ee9ad834 with a test OIDC provider registered; see the record for the fixture)
1. Account A (phone.demo) links IdP subject S (email = A's) → success.
2. Signed in as account B (auditor.demo), `POST /api/v1/auth/link-social {provider, callbackURL}` and complete the IdP round trip as subject S (email ≠ B's).
3. The callback answers 302 `/_console/login?error=email_does_not_match`; no account row is created (correct).
4. The console sees B is still signed in and redirects straight to the app landing page; the error is never rendered.

Expected: B sees why the link was refused (e.g. on the Linked accounts page or a toast).

UX defect, low severity; the refusal itself is correct.
